network_status.network: Evento alluvionale del 4-6 giugno 2002 nel territorio biellese
network_status.summary_it: Il Rio Borghesi fu interessato da trasporto in massa impulsivo; l'idrometro di Passobreve misura il Cervo e non rappresenta il colmo sul tributario al ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The Rio Borghesi experienced an impulsive mass-transport process; the Passobreve gauge measures the Cervo and does not represent the tributary peak at the bridge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
